resources.string: ClearFile prepares a simplified 2025 US federal return for study and demonstration. It is not IRS-authorized, cannot e-file, and must not be used to file a real tax return. Not tax advice — check with a qualified tax professional.
No AI: this app makes no network connections, stores no keys, and sends no data anywhere.
ClearFile is an independent study project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the IRS, Intuit, or TurboTax.
The file is too large to open — the limit is 512 MiB.
The file could not be opened as a ClearFile return.
